title: New emergency Fed lending program in 2024?
subtitle: In 2024
rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve creates a new emergency lending program or facility by 2024, then the market resolves to Yes.
early_close_condition: If this event occurs, the market will close the following 10am ET.

title: Will the Fed cut rates 0 times?
subtitle: 0:: 0 bps
rules_primary: If the Fed cuts 0 times before 2026, the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: To be clear, 25bp of cuts is equal to one cut (so 25bp cut is 1, 50bp cut is 2, 75bp cut is 3, and so on). Note: this detail has been included in past iterations including the previous iteration titled, "Number of rate cuts in 2024?"
